subject: Annual prepayment tap & replenish schedule — invoice cadence and VAT routing
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@cloudgrid.com>, CloudGrid Finance <finance@cloudgrid.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Oct 2025 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Annual prepayment tap & replenish schedule — invoice cadence and VAT routing

Hi Ellen / Finance team,

Thanks again for the productive call today. Attached is a proposed tap / replenish schedule for the annual prepayment tied to the RG-2025 commitment. High-level ask: confirm billing entity, PO number structure, and VAT handling so we can finalize the invoice cadence.

Proposal (summary):
- Total committed prepay: $600,000 for 12 months (placed as an upfront credit).
- Tap behavior: monthly drawdown up to a defined monthly cap ($50k), with automated replenish when balance falls below $120k (one-quarter buffer).
- Invoice cadence: we can issue a monthly drawdown invoice (1st business day) and an optional consolidated quarterly statement for your AP team.
- VAT routing: if CloudGrid requires EU-issued invoices for reverse-charge, we can issue from Redwood Inference B.V. (EU entity). Otherwise we will invoice from Redwood Inference, Inc. (US).

Action items for CloudGrid to confirm:
1) Which legal entity should we bill (US or EU)?
2) Do you prefer a single PO for the year or a PO per quarter/month?
3) Any special remit instructions (bank account or intermediaries)?

I attached a draft schedule (annual_tap_schedule.xlsx) with the monthly draw amounts and trigger thresholds. Once we get your answers we will generate the first invoice and provide a sample invoice PDF that shows VAT line treatment for your accounting.

Thanks — I’ve cc'd Kimberly to align billing ops and will pull Vanessa in if we need contract edits.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: annual_tap_schedule.xlsx
From: Ellen Park <ellen.park@cloudgrid.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, CloudGrid Finance <finance@cloudgrid.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 29 Oct 2025 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepayment tap & replenish schedule — invoice cadence and VAT routing

Thanks Marcus — this looks good. Quick clarifications from our side:

- We prefer to issue a single PO for the full year (CloudGrid PO# CG-2025-889). Is that okay for your system?
- Our accounting would like monthly invoices for cashflow but a consolidated quarterly statement for expense recognition — can you provide both?
- For VAT: CloudGrid Netherlands BV will be the invoiced entity (we will provide VAT ID shortly). We need the invoice to show the reverse-charge note and our VAT ID on the PDF. Can you provide a sample EU invoice layout?

If you can confirm those three items and send a sample invoice, we’ll get the PO and VAT ID over to you by end of week.

Best,
Ellen Park
Head of Finance Ops
CloudGrid

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ellen Park <ellen.park@cloudgrid.com>, CloudGrid Finance <finance@cloudgrid.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 30 Oct 2025 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Annual prepayment tap & replenish schedule — invoice cadence and VAT routing

Ellen — great, thanks for the quick reply. Answers below and next steps.

- Single PO: yes, we can accept one master PO (CG-2025-889). Please include the PO reference on each monthly invoice line so your AP system can auto-match.
- Monthly + consolidated quarterly: we will issue monthly drawdown invoices on the 1st business day and also publish a consolidated quarterly statement (same invoice numbers listed) on the 2nd business day of the first month of the following quarter. That should satisfy cashflow + recognition.
- VAT / Entity routing: we will issue invoices from Redwood Inference B.V. for any EU-based billing to enable reverse-charge. The invoice PDF will include: (a) CloudGrid Netherlands BV VAT ID, (b) the standard reverse-charge note, and (c) an explicit line for tax = 0 with a VAT reference.

I’ve attached the signed SOW stub for your records (cloudgrid_signed_sow.pdf) and updated the schedule to flag the first invoice date once we receive the PO and VAT ID.

DocuSign / next steps:
- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567
- DocuSign signature (if needed): https://www.docusign.com/rg/embeddedSign/abcd-1234

If everything looks good I’ll ask billing to draft the first monthly invoice targeted for 2025-11-03 (first business day of Nov). Vanessa (cc) will coordinate the ledger and invoice numbering.

Marcus / Vanessa — internal confirmation:

- We will register the billing for this account under Redwood Inference B.V. for invoices to CloudGrid Netherlands BV.
- Invoice dates: monthly invoices will be generated on the 1st business day (target 2025-11-03 for the first).
- Invoice content: include CloudGrid VAT ID, the reverse-charge statement, and a tax line set to 0 with a VAT reference.
- PO handling: we will include the master PO (CG-2025-889) on every invoice line for your AP auto-match.

Vanessa — please prepare the first monthly invoice draft and the consolidated quarterly statement template. Marcus — once we have PO and VAT ID we will finalize numbering and send the sample PDF to Ellen.
